+8 Enhancement Bonus: +8 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Holy 5: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 5d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Healing Lore +19: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 19% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Devotion +128: Passive: +128 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +46 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
